incomplete-plot.text: Among 220 directly simulated alternatives, ALT-017 looks inexpensive on a cost-versus-volume plot.
But $54.99k and a 4.14% modeled volume reduction do not satisfy the 6% target. Its selected-storm peak guardrail also fails.
The plot was honest. It was incomplete. An attractive projection is not the same as an acceptable alternative.

modeled-water-ledger.text: Hold the long synthetic storm fixed at 0.937 acre-feet of modeled precipitation.
Compared with baseline, ALT-207 changes SWMM's runoff-accounting ledger: infiltration loss, surface runoff, final storage, and LID drainage.
For this event, modeled OUT1 volume changes from 0.167 to 0.150 million gallons. Across four separate events, it changes from 0.748 to 0.700 million gallons.
That is about 48,000 fewer modeled gallons at OUT1—not measured recharge, water quality, habitat, or avoided flooding.

storm-reveals.text: All 699 exact alternatives face four selected synthetic rainfall patterns.
Peak-flow increases appear for 1, 0, 420, and 47 alternatives by storm. Reconciliation leaves 421 unique adverse alternatives, with 47 failing twice.
The deeper stress storm was not the most revealing test here. Depth, duration, and shape changed together, so this is not a universal storm rule.

decision-funnel.text: Start with 699 directly simulated alternatives. All 699 pass execution QA.
The declared rules narrow them to 297 volume passes, 46 volume-and-cost passes, 12 complete-rule passes, and 4 exact feasible-frontier points.
The model focuses field investigation. It does not finish site feasibility, constructability, maintenance, or model review.

search-release-gate.text: Search chooses a candidate question. Four direct SWMM jobs supply that candidate's hydraulic answers.
Four search methods take the same controlled exam across three budgets and ten seeds: 120 benchmark replays.
At 256 requests, ExtraTrees reaches 1.000 median hypervolume, 83.3% feasible recall, and 46.2% adverse recall—but passes only one of five release gates.
Adaptive ML remains experimental. Production uses scrambled Sobol. Computational energy and carbon were not measured.
